answer: When many masks share one hidden mind, their money and invites leave an echo: trace each agent's funding path and vouch edges through the graph, and the clones collapse to one node. Identities that bloom from a single lotus root (same wallet ancestor, same invite tree) draw from one shared reputation budget, not many. Forging a truly independent pearl of history then means paying for separate capital and distinct social ties, so every extra sybil costs real funds and time, never a free copy.
